evals.prompt: I have a stable skill in the current project and I found a missing behavior while using it. Help me improve it without losing the repo as the source of truth.
evals.expected_output: Classify the request as ITERATE-FROM-PROJECT, preserve the base ref, and explain the backport path.

evals.prompt: Please install this stable skill into Claude Code and OpenCode, then verify that both targets load the expected source ref.
evals.expected_output: Classify the request as DISTRIBUTE and mention target-specific install verification.

evals.prompt: I want to pilot a candidate skill in a real project first, record metadata, and only backport generic improvements if the trial goes well.
evals.expected_output: Classify the request as PILOT-IN-PROJECT and require install metadata plus a backport gate.

evals.prompt: My project-specific workaround depends on this repo path and should stay local unless you can prove it is generic.
evals.expected_output: Classify the request as a project overlay and avoid backporting it by default.
